name: Pixxel
short: Order new hyperspectral satellite captures by API.
summary: Pixxel (Bengaluru and US) sells hyperspectral satellite imagery from its own Firefly constellation through its Aurora platform: tasking orders (single or recurring) over a GeoJSON polygon and capture window, archive search and order, and delivery to a cloud store, all through a bearer-token REST API (api.pixxel.space/v0) or the Order Desk web app. Tasking is priced per km2 in prepaid tokens (1 token = 1 USD); accounts must pass KYB or KYC before the Order Desk opens.

tasks: task a new hyperspectral capture (VNIR bandset) over a polygon within a capture window, once or recurring
feasibility check of AOI, window and cloud cover before ordering (dry_run on the API)
search and order archive hyperspectral scenes (STAC)
deliver to an S3-style cloud store
run analytics (indices, insights, workflows) on delivered imagery

pricing.notes: Pricing docs: tasking VNIR $8/km2; archive VNIR $6/km2 (20% off if older than a year); 1 token = 1 USD. Tasking API doc: orders under 100 km2 are billed as 100 km2. Cloud cover up to 10% adds 15%; up to 20% no uplift. Express 24 h delivery is listed as coming soon (+20%). Other bandsets and analytics have separate pricing not read.

latency.typical: Capture window of at least 14 days (regular tasking); delivery 72 h after capture (tasking guide) or 14 days (pricing page)
latency.notes: The tasking guide says Standard delivery is 72 hours from capture; the pricing page says 'Standard delivery - 14 days from capture time'. Start date must be at least 24 hours after order placement. Docs say feasibility 'does not guarantee' fulfilment; recurring tasks that are infeasible are cancelled and not charged.

regions: Not stated; feasibility is checked per AOI
coverage.notes: No country list or geographic limit found in the docs read. Coverage depends on Firefly orbits, weather and scheduling; the feasibility check returns feasible, not feasible or failed.

licensing.summary: Pixxel Imagery EULA v1.0 (23 May 2025): limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence for internal use (reformat, copy, modify, display on an isolated non-commercial basis, share with need-to-know contractors). Without Pixxel's written permission you may not sublicense, sell, rent, lease or transfer imagery to a third party. Pixxel owns the imagery and 'may retain copies of any or all Imagery and data its satellite collects for any purpose'. The EULA does not mention AI or ML training.

human.unknown: Captured by satellites; no per-person identity check applies. Buyers are KYB/KYC checked, which is a requester check, not a capture guarantee.

application.unknown: No device or app attestation is documented for delivered files.

camera.unknown: Not a signed capture, so none (STANDARD §3). What is stated: Metadata file in the delivered package. Sensor identity comes from Pixxel's own metadata XML (capture date, sensor details, processing and copyright information) in each package.

time.unknown: Capture time is in Pixxel's metadata; no independent time-stamp scheme is documented.

location.unknown: Deliveries are UTM GeoTIFFs plus a footprint GeoJSON; no accuracy figure or independent check was read.

content.unknown: No integrity or anti-manipulation method (signing, hashes) is documented; cloud cover is a request constraint, not a guarantee.

corroboration.unknown: No cross-check against other sources is documented.

freshness.typical_age: Tasking: captured inside your window after you order; archive: existing scenes
freshness.notes: Search the archive first, task only if nothing fits.

auth.how_to_get: Sign in to Aurora (aurora.pixxel.space), Settings > Personal Access Tokens, create a token with a role, project access and expiry; send 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. The Order Desk needs KYB (business) or KYC (individual, ID document, selfie and proof of residence) approval first.

endpoints.notes: Orders must be linked to a project_id; service account must be added to the project in the UI
Bandset id required for a tasking item
Dry run validates, runs feasibility and checks wallet tokens without placing the order

endpoints.params: dry_run=false, order_items[] (bandset, geometry FeatureCollection with one polygon, name, cloud_cover, delivery_speed STANDARD, cloud_delivery, project_id, recurrence ONCE|WEEKLY|MONTHLY, start_date, end_date, usecase)
endpoints.notes: Tasking or archive order; deducts tokens

api.rate_limits: Not published in the docs read.
api.notes: The docs site (Mintlify-style) serves llms.txt and per-page .md files. No OAuth, dynamic registration or MCP server found.

delivery.basis: Pricing page: 'Regular Tasking: Provides a capture window of minimum 14 days'; tasking guide: 'Standard' delivery '72 hours' from capture.

payment.notes: Tokens (1 = 1 USD) bought via Stripe by workspace owners or admins with card or bank transfer; transfers over $5000 are wire only. The API spends tokens from the wallet; no agent-native payment rail found.

requester.checks: KYB for businesses (company name and country, registered address, website, optional supporting documents) or KYC for individuals (ID document, selfie, proof of residence) before Order Desk access; the organisation owner gets an approval email.
requester.unknown: Review time and rejection criteria are not published; whether sanctions or end-use screening applies is not stated.
